limitations: Isolated Linux Chromium142 with trusted CDP touch at mobile viewport sizes. This does not establish Android OS picker rendering.
The pending-selection cancellation case deliberately holds only the RAF scheduled by native onchange, then releases it after a later real native pan; this is an explicit scheduler seam.
The existing fixture controls device speech voices. Bundled playback uses the exact production MP3 and native HTMLMediaElement clock.
